request.prompt: Create exactly ONE faithful full-body 2D game sprite of the adult character Jack in her Mass Effect 2 LOYALTY outfit, using the supplied full-body reference as the visual authority. Preserve the exact outfit variant and the same relaxed upright three-quarter stance: shaved head and recognizable facial structure, dark eye makeup, visible original neck/arm/abdomen tattoos, fitted sleeveless black high-collared zip-front vest, exposed tattooed midriff, asymmetric grey fabric panels draped across the hips, dark fitted trousers, and the tall black boots with their individual rows of buckled straps. Keep both hands lowered and both boots fully visible, with the same asymmetry and weight distribution as the reference. Faithfully retain the silhouette, anatomy, proportions, surface pattern placement, seams, fasteners, colors and material contrast. Render as a detailed realistic game-asset cutout with crisp readable edges and restrained neutral studio lighting. One subject and one pose only. Entire head, both hands and the soles of both boots must be inside the canvas. Make the subject occupy about 80 percent of image height, leaving generous empty transparent padding above the head, under the soles and beside the body. Transparent background throughout; remove the white backdrop and blue background halo of the reference. No scenery, floor, contact shadow, aura, labels, text, logo, border, weapon, additional person or duplicate view. Do not redesign the outfit, add accessories or substitute another Mass Effect costume.

notes: One full body inspected, with both boots and hands.
Secondary 2013 community-hosted render; extraction author unknown.
Fine tattoos and hidden surfaces remain unvalidated.
